item.title: Family of 6 displaced after fire at Hallsley home in Chesterfield
item.description: Chesterfield Fire and EMS responded to a three-story home fire late Saturday, bringing it under control in about 30 minutes.

item.title: Hope Cartwright's family issues statement as community mourns Virginia Living Magazine editor
item.description: Family of Hope Cartwright, Virginia Living Magazine editor killed in Richmond hit-and-run, releases statement asking for privacy while grieving.

item.title: Northumberland student Jaivion Henderson illustrates children's book: 'Color and imagination'
item.description: Northumberland seventh-grader Jaivion Henderson illustrated "Odin, the Lonely Lion," a children's book about kindness and forgiveness written by his aunt Quintese Kenner.
